description_en: Deletes a protected directory from a specified server
description_zh: 删除指定服务器的防护目录
name: ModifyWebLockDeleteConfig

parameters.description_en: The IP address of the access source.
parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.description_en:
The language type for requests and responses. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.
parameters.description_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：

- **zh**：中文

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the protected directory to delete.
> You can call the [DescribeWebLockConfigList](~~DescribeWebLockConfigList~~) operation to obtain the ID of the protected directory.
